description: This file defines a React functional component 'Login' for a front-end login page for the Paper+ branded application. It handles user input for email and password, simulates authentication by setting a flag and storing user info in local storage, and navigates to the dashboard upon submission. The component includes styling and branding elements with no backend calls.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component implementing a login interface, managing form state, handling form submission, and navigating upon login.
